_comment: desc = short visual description (CLIP only reads ~77 tokens, keep it tight). art = fields copied from src/characters/roster*.ts.

bolivar.name: Simón Bolívar
bolivar.title: El Libertador
bolivar.desc: Simon Bolivar, 19th century South American general, dark curly hair, sideburns, navy blue tailcoat with heavy gold embroidery and gold epaulettes, red sash, white trousers, black boots, holding a curved sabre

sanmartin.name: José de San Martín
sanmartin.title: El Padre de la Patria
sanmartin.desc: Jose de San Martin, Argentine general, dark wavy hair, thick sideburns, black bicorne hat, dark blue military coat with gold embroidery and large gold epaulettes, short cape, white trousers, black boots, curved sabre

tupacamaru.name: Túpac Amaru II
tupacamaru.title: El Inca Rebelde
tupacamaru.desc: Tupac Amaru II, powerful Andean Inca nobleman, long black hair with woven llautu headband, red and gold patterned unku tunic, striped red and blue poncho, gold jewelry, ceremonial staff, muscular heavy build, sandals

sucre.name: Antonio José de Sucre
sucre.title: El Gran Mariscal
sucre.desc: Antonio Jose de Sucre, slim young Venezuelan marshal, short dark hair, sideburns, bicorne hat, dark green military coat with gold buttons and epaulettes, gold sash, cream trousers, black boots, straight sword

louverture.name: Toussaint Louverture
louverture.title: El Espartaco Negro
louverture.desc: distant full length view, small figure, Toussaint Louverture, Haitian revolutionary general, dark brown skin, black bicorne hat with white feather, navy blue coat with gold leaf embroidery, red collar, white cravat, red sash, gold epaulettes, black boots, straight sword

hidalgo.name: Miguel Hidalgo
hidalgo.title: El Padre de la Independencia Mexicana
hidalgo.desc: Miguel Hidalgo, elderly Mexican priest, white hair bald on top, black clerical cassock with white collar, large gold cross necklace, dark cloak, shouting fiercely, holding a lit torch and a sword

morelos.name: José María Morelos
morelos.title: El Siervo de la Nación
morelos.desc: Jose Maria Morelos, stocky Mexican insurgent priest-general, white cloth turban on head, white shirt, dark olive coat, crossed leather bandolier, red sash, gold epaulettes, heavy muscular build, sword

ohiggins.name: Bernardo O'Higgins
ohiggins.title: El Libertador de Chile
ohiggins.desc: Bernardo O'Higgins, Chilean general, fair skin, brown hair, sideburns, tall black shako hat, dark blue coat with gold embroidered collar and large gold epaulettes, red white and blue sash, white trousers, black boots, sabre

artigas.name: José Gervasio Artigas
artigas.title: El Protector de los Pueblos Libres
artigas.desc: Jose Artigas standing on foot, Uruguayan caudillo, dark hair, sideburns, black tricorn hat, dark blue military jacket, red neckerchief, brown poncho over shoulder, trousers, black boots, short facon knife in hand

miranda.name: Francisco de Miranda
miranda.title: El Precursor
miranda.desc: distant full length view, small figure, Francisco de Miranda, older Venezuelan general, long swept-back grey white hair, clean shaven, dark navy and tan military coat with gold trim, red waistcoat, tricorn hat, holding a flintlock pistol and a sword

guemes.name: Martín Miguel de Güemes
guemes.title: El General Gaucho
guemes.desc: Martin Miguel de Guemes, Argentine gaucho general, wide-brim black gaucho hat, black curly hair, full dark beard and moustache, flowing red poncho, white shirt, gaucho trousers, boots with spurs, long facon knife

cordova.name: José María Córdova
cordova.title: El Héroe de Ayacucho
cordova.desc: Jose Maria Cordova, young Colombian general, dark hair, thick moustache, dark navy coat with gold embroidery and gold epaulettes, white trousers, black boots, slim athletic build, drawn sabre

juarez.name: Benito Juárez
juarez.title: El Benemérito
juarez.desc: Benito Juarez, short stocky Zapotec Mexican president, short black hair, stern face, black formal frock coat and waistcoat, white shirt, black bow tie, dark trousers, black shoes, holding a rolled constitution scroll

guerrero.name: Vicente Guerrero
guerrero.title: El Tigre del Sur
guerrero.desc: Vicente Guerrero, strong dark-skinned Mexican insurgent general, big curly black afro hair, moustache, white shirt, dark waistcoat, red and white sash, gold epaulettes, heavy muscular build, sword

iturbide.name: Agustín de Iturbide
iturbide.title: El Emperador
iturbide.desc: Agustin de Iturbide, Mexican emperor, dark hair, sideburns, gold laurel crown, dark blue uniform heavy gold embroidery and epaulettes, green white and red tricolor sash, ermine trimmed imperial cape, sabre

marti.name: José Martí
marti.title: El Apóstol de Cuba
marti.desc: Jose Marti, slim Cuban poet, dark wavy hair, large moustache, black frock coat, white shirt, black tie, dark trousers, black shoes, holding a glowing quill pen

micaela.name: Micaela Bastidas
micaela.title: La Estratega Rebelde
micaela.desc: Micaela Bastidas, Andean indigenous woman warrior, long black braids, woven headband, gold earrings, red and gold embroidered tunic, purple and teal poncho, leather bracers, long skirt, boots, coiled whip

katari.name: Túpac Katari
katari.title: El Cerco de La Paz
katari.desc: Tupac Katari, Aymara rebel leader, long black hair, red woven chullo cap with feathers, red and blue striped poncho, dark tunic, heavy muscular build, leather sling weapon, sandals

manco.name: Manco Inca
manco.title: El Inca de Vilcabamba
manco.desc: Manco Inca, Inca emperor warrior, tall red and orange feather headdress with gold sun disc, long black hair, gold embroidered tunic, golden breastplate, red cape, gold bracers, holding a long spear

belgrano.name: Manuel Belgrano
belgrano.title: El Creador de la Bandera
belgrano.desc: Manuel Belgrano, Argentine general, curly dark hair, sideburns, black bicorne hat, dark navy military coat with gold buttons, white cravat, light blue and white sash, white trousers, black boots, sabre
